subject: Re: POC plan & RACI for ClearLake Medical trial
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>, Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>, Dr. Samuel Liao <samuel.liao@clearlakemedical.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC planning recap & next steps

Thanks again for the 30-minute call today — great to meet the ClearLake team. As promised, a short recap and proposed next steps to kick off the 4-week POC/trial. Please review and confirm owners and success criteria so we can finalize the mutual action plan.

High-level goal:
- Validate Redwood Inference can serve critical clinical summarization workflows at <= 350ms p95 and run on your VPC instance with our private deployment option.

Proposed success criteria (draft):
- Functional: 95% of sampled clinical notes summarized accurately per your evaluation rubric (precision-focused).
- Performance: p95 latency <= 350ms for 512-token summaries (target traffic: 5 req/s).
- Security/Compliance: Data stays in your VPC, KMS key used for model inputs, SOC2 evidence provided.

POC scope and timeline (target 4 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm RACI, security contacts, procurement steps, and environment access.
- Week 1: Private deployment into ClearLake VPC + smoke tests.
- Week 2: Integration with sample dataset, run metrics, and initial qualitative QA.
- Week 3: Customer eval, edge-case / safety review.
- Week 4: Final report, recommendations, and ops handoff.

Requested owners (please confirm):
- Infra/Network: ClearLake infra owner (we need VPC peering/VPN details).
- App/Product owner: who will validate functional success criteria and provide sample dataset.
- Security/Compliance: person to sign off on KMS/retention and receive SOC2 evidence.
- Procurement: person for the trial agreement (if required) and PO steps.

Attachments: clearlake-poc-map.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), clearlake-poc-sla.pdf (trial SLA primer).

Next steps: If we can confirm owners and a preferred kick-off date (ideally this Thursday or next Monday), Dev will provision the environment.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
Attachment: clearlake-poc-map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>
Cc: Dr. Samuel Liao <samuel.liao@clearlakemedical.com>, procurement@clearlakemedical.com, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning recap & next steps

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear plan. High level: we're aligned with a 4-week trial. Quick answers and owners from our side: 

- Infra/Network owner: Arjun Mehta (me) — I'll own VPC peering, firewall rules, and endpoint provisioning.
- App/Product owner: Dr. Samuel Liao — he will provide the sample dataset and final functional acceptance criteria.
- Security/Compliance: Priya Rao — will review KMS and data retention; SOC2 evidence requests go to her.
- Procurement: procurement@clearlakemedical.com — they'll handle any MSA/trial paperwork and PO creation.

Couple of asks before we start provisioning:
1) Can you confirm the exact KMS integration method (bring-your-own-key vs. Redwood-managed)?
2) Are there any IP allowlist requirements for our egress?
3) We'll need a short runbook for rolling back access after the trial.

I've looped procurement and added Dev on the cc to coordinate the environment details. Proposed kick-off: Thu, Mar 5 (our morning) works.

—Arjun
Director, Infrastructure | ClearLake Medical
arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC planning recap & next steps

Thanks Arjun — I'll own provisioning once we have the network details. Quick answers from the Redwood ops side: 

- KMS: We support both BYOK (recommended for production) and Redwood-managed keys for trials. For this POC we can do BYOK; please share the KMS key ARN or we can test with a short-lived Redwood-managed key first.
- IP allowlist: We'll provide the outbound IPs for the private deployment; if you need inbound allowlisting for management, let me know.
- Rollback: I'll prepare a rollback/runbook that removes routes and deprovisions the environment; we'll hand it over to your infra team post-trial.

I'll aim to have the initial provisioning checklist by Wed EOD. Lauren — can you confirm if Thu Mar 5 AM (PST) is still the preferred kick-off?

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>
Cc: Dr. Samuel Liao <samuel.liao@clearlakemedical.com>, procurement@clearlakemedical.com
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC planning recap & next steps

Quick security notes from my side:
- Priya (security/compliance) will own SOC2 evidence intake and KMS sign-off. I need the template of the SOC2 artifact and a short data-flow diagram.
- Data residency: data must remain within our US region and logs should be retained for 90 days.
- Minimal access principle: service accounts only for infra access; no human keys.

One more ask: can Redwood share a brief summary of hardened network endpoints and where logs are stored during the trial?

Thanks — I'll review the mutual action plan and confirm if any edits are needed.

Best,
Priya Rao
Head of Security & Compliance | ClearLake Medical
priya@clearlakemedical.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>, Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 08:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC planning recap & next steps

Hi all — I'm Stephanie from Customer Success, looping in to own the evaluation plan and customer-side coordination. A few notes: 

- Evaluation plan: we'll run a 200-sample blind eval and a daily metrics dashboard (latency, token cost, accuracy) for your product team.
- Success criteria confirmation: Dr. Liao — can you share the rubric for "accurate" summaries (scale or checklist)?
- CS support: we can provide a few dedicated office hours per week during week 2–3 for prompt tuning and QA.

If everyone is good, I'll add the evaluation checklist to the mutual action plan and schedule the weekly sync.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Arjun Mehta <arjun.mehta@clearlakemedical.com>, Priya Rao <priya@clearlakemedical.com>, Dr. Samuel Liao <samuel.liao@clearlakemedical.com>, procurement@clearlakemedical.com
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC plan & RACI for ClearLake Medical trial — confirmed owners & next steps

Thanks everyone for the quick responses — summarizing confirmed owners and immediate next steps so nothing slips through the cracks: 

Confirmed RACI (POC):
- Responsible (Infra/Network): Arjun Mehta (ClearLake) — VPC peering, firewall rules, provide egress/ingress requirements.
- Responsible (Provisioning/Runbook): Dev Patel (Redwood) — provisioning checklist and rollback runbook.
- Accountable (Functional Acceptance): Dr. Samuel Liao (ClearLake) — provides dataset and signs off on evaluation rubric.
- Consulted (Security): Priya Rao (ClearLake) — SOC2/KMS sign-off, data residency confirmation.
- Informed (Procurement): procurement@clearlakemedical.com — will handle any trial MSA/PO.
- Support (Evaluation & QA): Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood CS) — leads evaluation plan and weekly syncs.

Immediate next steps (owners/action dates):
- Arjun: Send VPC peering details + any allowlist needs by EOD Thu Mar 5.
- Dev: Share provisioning checklist and rollback runbook by Wed Mar 4 EOD (in practice I mean EOD local; Dev already said Wed EOD).
- Priya: Confirm SOC2 artifact template and data residency note by Fri Mar 6.
- Dr. Liao: Share evaluation rubric and a 200-sample dataset by Mon Mar 9.
- Procurement: Confirm if a trial MSA/PO is required by Mon Mar 9.

I'll update the mutual action plan (clearlake-poc-map.xlsx) with this RACI and queue a 30-min kick-off on Thu Mar 5 9:30am PST unless you prefer another time.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com
Attachment: clearlake-poc-sla.pdf (application/pdf)
